stages.title: Meaning first
stages.body: Establish the intended proposition before editing form.

stages.title: Finite-verb scan
stages.body: Check completeness, agreement and tense before minor wording.

stages.title: Noun and pronoun scan
stages.body: Check countability, determiners, case, reference and number.

stages.title: Pattern scan
stages.body: Check prepositions, phrasal verbs, word form, modifiers and parallelism.

stages.title: Minimal repair
stages.body: Change only the defective element and preserve acceptable wording.

stages.title: Voice eligibility
stages.body: Confirm a suitable object before forming a passive.

stages.title: Voice mechanics
stages.body: Preserve tense, aspect, modal and necessary agent.

stages.title: Narration purpose
stages.body: Choose said, told, asked, requested, advised or ordered by function.

stages.title: Backshift and deixis
stages.body: Change tense, pronouns, time and place only when context requires.

stages.title: Transformation conditions
stages.body: Apply no sooner, unless, too-to, despite and degree patterns only when meaning survives.

stages.title: Focus and tags
stages.body: Preserve only-scope and derive tags from polarity and auxiliary.

stages.title: Timed error log
stages.body: Code the miss, state the rule, rewrite and retry a fresh item.
